title_ja: 可観測性・性能工学・電力適応運用
title_en: Observability, performance engineering, and power-aware operations
summary_ja: ジョブ、通信、I/O、電力・冷却の観測を性能モデルと運用制御へ接続する暫定ロードマップです。研究上の電力制御結果と、センター全体で安全に運用できる制御を区別します。
summary_en: A provisional roadmap connecting job, communication, I/O, power, and cooling telemetry to performance models and operational controls. Research power-capping results are separated from controls proven safe for center-wide operation.

tracks.name_ja: 共通テレメトリと再現測定
tracks.summary_ja: 性能、電力、待ち時間、失敗を同じ実行単位で記録します。
tracks.summary_en: Record performance, power, queueing, and failures for the same execution unit.
tracks.current_state_ja: 既存資料は個別ツールやシステムの計測機能を示しますが、HPCI全体で共通の意味・粒度・保持期間は未確定です。 今回の限定的な追補：今回の公式Graph500読書記録で2026年6月BFSの富岳3位、204,068 GTEPS、scale 43、152,064ノードを確認した。10月の新計測ではなく、旧取得失敗は履歴として保持する。Benchpark文書の再実行時の出力上書き注意を踏まえ、各反復の別出力・設定・build identityを保存する評価条件を追加する。適合度は独立holdout誤差ではない。 AIPerfのper-chunk usage補正はoption・endpointの対応と先頭chunkのtoken情報に依存し、版更新だけで補正済みとはしない。moving mainのgoodputは適合requests/s、attainmentはvalidとerroredを含む分母の割合として区別し、guideの混同を残す。GPU-only energyはwarmupを除外し、energy/userのconfigured concurrency分母を、科学課題成功あたりのwhole-SUT energyと混同しない。mainの式をv0.13.0へ自動帰属せず、容量外挿は未検証。 author-hosted filesystem研究は平均予測と変動の差を示すが、placeholder出版識別子、PolarisのLustre/GPFS不一致、script/data未取得を保持し、再現済みとはしない。BP5の選択・切詰めreplayは元step/event identityを保持する必要があり、SST network復旧とは別である。queue step数とbyte high-water markを分け、held-out tail errorを評価する条件を追加する。 DarshanではMPI終了処理を欠くcrashでログが残らないことがあり、sacctの未対応仮想メモリ値の0、中断stepのCPU欠測、明示的truncateを利用実態と区別する。実効取得周期（0は終了時のみ）、collector版、window・timezone・月跨ぎ規則、job/step分母と完了条件別の観測率を保持する。missing・unsupported・suppressedを計測zeroにしない。公開制御を維持し、新たなHPCI利用値や需要傾向は作らない。
tracks.current_state_en: Existing material documents measurement capabilities for individual tools and systems, but common HPCI-wide semantics, granularity, and retention are unresolved. Scoped additions in this batch: The official Graph500 receipt verifies Fugaku third in June 2026 BFS: 204,068 GTEPS, scale 43, 152,064 nodes. This is not an October measurement; retain the prior failed-read history. Benchpark warns that reruns overwrite outputs, motivating separate result/configuration/build identities for repetitions. Fit quality is not independent holdout accuracy. AIPerf per-chunk usage correction depends on option/endpoint support and first-chunk token information; upgrading alone is insufficient. Moving-main goodput is compliant requests/s whereas attainment is a fraction over valid plus errored requests; preserve conflicting guide terminology. GPU-only energy excludes warmup and configured-concurrency energy/user differs from whole-SUT energy per successful scientific task. Main formulas are not automatically attributed to v0.13.0; capacity extrapolation remains unvalidated. The author-hosted filesystem study distinguishes mean prediction from variability; retain placeholder publication identifiers, Polaris Lustre/GPFS inconsistency and unavailable scripts/data, without reproduction claims. Selected/truncated BP5 replay must preserve original step/event identity, distinct from SST network recovery. Separate queue-step bounds from byte high-water marks and assess held-out tail error. Darshan crashes without MPI finalization can leave no logs; distinguish unsupported sacct virtual-memory zeros, interrupted-step CPU omissions and explicit truncation from usage. Retain effective cadence (zero means termination-only), collector versions, windows/timezones/month-crossing rules, job/step denominators and completion-conditioned coverage. Missing, unsupported and suppressed values are not measured zeros. Preserve disclosure controls; derive no new HPCI usage values or demand trends.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 候補構成を同じ入力、版、精度、計測境界で比較できる観測契約が必要です。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Candidate systems need an observability contract with identical inputs, versions, correctness, and measurement boundaries.

tracks.name_ja: ジョブ別電力制御と施設連携
tracks.name_en: Per-job power control and facility coordination
tracks.summary_ja: 性能・エネルギー・期限の関係を負荷別に扱います。
tracks.summary_en: Treat performance, energy, and deadlines by workload.
tracks.current_state_ja: ORNLのGH200研究はタスク別の電力上限の有効性を示しますが、全負荷・全候補機・本番運用への一般化はできません。OCPの800 VDC資料は施設側の標準化活動です。 今回の限定的な追補：NVIDIAのGPU board-average powerは前1秒・AmpereのGA100例外、instantaneousは直近、moduleは対応CPU等を含むHopper以降datacenter条件で、poll周期だけから範囲・積分窓を決めない。冷却モデルv2は欠けた係数を手調整し、1秒simulationを15分比較、約520日profileを評価するが独立holdout分割は不明で高変動を過小評価する。公開codeを実行・data変換をauditしておらず、閉ループsimulationを施設省エネ実測としない。
tracks.current_state_en: ORNL's GH200 study shows task-specific power-cap effects, but cannot be generalized to every workload, platform, or production service. OCP's 800 VDC material concerns facility-side standardization. Scoped additions in this batch: NVIDIA board-average power covers the preceding second with the GA100 exception in Ampere support; instantaneous is latest and module includes supported CPU/components for Hopper-and-newer datacenter products. Poll cadence alone does not fix boundary/integration windows. Cooling-model v2 manually tunes unavailable coefficients, reduces one-second simulation to 15-minute comparison over about 520 daily profiles, lacks a stated independent holdout split and underestimates variability. Available code/data transforms were not reproduced/audited; closed-loop simulation is not measured facility savings.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 電力上限の安全性、性能劣化、復旧、施設負荷追従をアプリケーション別に検証します。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Validate power-cap safety, performance impact, recovery, and facility-load following per application.

A provisional plan to review a comparison contract pinning input, version, correctness, timing interval, IT/facility power boundary, and failures. For experimental streams, OpenFS proposes separately reporting scheduled-versus-actual issue, reconciliation of all steps, backpressure versus skipping, premature termination and tail sample size. Joint quality/deadline/loss measurement remains unexecuted. Proposed review criteria include requested/allocated/used distinctions, transformation/exclusion versions, external-trace applicability, and disclosure risk across monthly and revised releases. These are OpenFS proposals, not external delivery commitments. Proposed evaluation additionally distinguishes requested/applied caps, acquisition/preprocessing cadence, sensor boundaries, approximation, overhead/calibration accuracy and nonrandom operational comparisons. An additional OpenFS evaluation proposal records driver, allocator/memory mode, effective MPI placement and patch version to avoid confusing configuration changes with portability differences. Vendor statements are not HPCI measurements; no new acceptance threshold or deployment date is set. Additional criteria: preserve separate repetition results/build identities; pin actual hardware/driver/fields, unsupported values and sensor integration windows, distinguishing calibration from holdouts. Streaming-token corrections depend on options/endpoints; distinguish GPU-only energy/configured concurrency from whole-SUT scientific-success denominators. Retain original replay event IDs, byte high-water marks, held-out tail errors and monthly cohorts/month-crossing rules; missing/unsupported/suppressed values are not measured zeros. These are not new measurements or relaxed disclosure controls.
milestones.label_ja: 性能・電力観測契約の暫定判断点
milestones.label_en: Provisional performance and power observability gate
milestones.detail_ja: 入力、版、精度、計測区間、IT/施設電力境界、失敗を固定した比較形式を審査する暫定計画です。 実験streamでは、予定到着と実投入の差、全stepの照合、backpressureと省略、途中終了、tail推定の標本数を別記することを提案します。品質・期限・欠損の同時測定は未実施です。 審査候補として、要求・割当・使用の区別、変換・除外版、外部トレースの適用範囲、月次・訂正版を通じた開示リスク確認を含めます。これはOpenFSの提案であり外部組織の納期ではありません。 追加の評価案では要求capと適用cap、取得周期と前処理周期、センサ範囲、近似、overhead・較正精度、非無作為な実績比較を区別する。 OpenFSの追加評価案として、ドライバ、割当・メモリ方式、実効MPI配置、パッチ版も記録し、設定変更を性能可搬性の差と混同しない。ベンダー記述はHPCI実測ではなく、合否閾値や導入日は新設しない。 追補条件：各反復の結果・build identityを独立保存する。実hardware/driver/field、未対応値、sensor積分窓を固定し、較正とholdoutを分ける。stream token補正はoption/endpoint依存、GPU-only energy・configured concurrencyとwhole-SUT科学成功分母を分ける。元replay event ID、byte high-water mark、held-out tail誤差、月次cohort・月跨ぎ規則を記録し、missing/unsupported/suppressedを計測zeroにしない。新しい実測や公開制御の解除ではない。

caveat_ja: 単一のAIモデル・単一エージェントによる暫定調査です。独立したAIモデルによるConsensus Gateは未完了です。公表された実績、組織・企業の目標、OpenFSの暫定判断点を区別し、未公表の時期、性能、費用は推測していません。
caveat_en: Provisional research by one model and one agent; the Consensus Gate using independent models is incomplete. Observed events, organization or vendor targets, and provisional OpenFS gates are separated, and unpublished timing, performance, and cost are not inferred.
